page.overview:
Who is Pangea?

Her origin is unknown other than she tried out to be apart of the new roster for the Guardians of the Globe but did not get in.

Pangea was captured by Doc Seismic and his subterranean beasts alongside many other heroes before being rescued by Darkwing II and the ReAnimen.

She was one of many heroes led by Brit into a teleporter to help fight the evil variants of Invincible. She is later seen fighting Hoodvincible alongside Two Punch Man, Shrapnel, and Burly before Invincible and Atom Eve swoop in to help. She was knocked unconscious offscreen along with the rest of the heroes aside from Atom Eve and Invincible before Omnivincible joins the battle.

After the Invincible War, she is seen amongst the heroes providing aid, pulling a civilian from the rubble. She also watches Powerplex rant against Invincible while being dragged away.
